subject: E-3307: quota exceeded on Android
body:
Hello support team. We run MeshMail 2.8.1 on Android 14
(Galaxy S23). Whenever I start a sync since the weekend, the
app shows 'E-3307: storage quota exceeded'.

Our quota includes a large folder a partner company shared
with us. That shared folder by itself exceeds our entire
plan.

What I tried so far: rebooting the router. No luck.

Mei Lin -- Tessa Labs. Appreciate any pointers.
